recipe.visualDefinition: A soft-focus studio portrait of a woman with voluminous 80s-style feathered hair, reclining amidst draped satin fabrics. The composition uses a muted grey background contrasted with high-sheen black and pink textiles, topped with a distinct two-tier typographic header.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's pink knit sweater echoing the pink satin drapes
High-contrast black satin in the foreground framing the lower right
Horizontal pink rule line separating primary and secondary text
Soft, diffused lighting creating a gentle glow on the subject's face
coreInvariants: Hand-drawn script for the primary display text
Diagonal corner badge in the top right

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally, positioned in the lower two-thirds of the frame, leaning forward with hand to face.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the high-contrast black satin fold in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large script at the top, follows the pink rule line down to the subject's eyes, then moves along the diagonal satin folds.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open grey space in the upper left and right quadrants around the head.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral grey background providing a stable base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black satin creating depth and weight in the foreground.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft pastel pink in the clothing, fabric, and horizontal rule line.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the black fabric and white text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Fluid, lowercase-heavy cursive script for the top line; high-contrast serif for the bottom line.
letterConstructionRules: Top line: Extended horizontal swashes, varying line weights, and disconnected loops.
Bottom line: Modern serif with vertical stress and thin hairlines.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'a' with an elongated, circular tail
Lowercase 'f' with a long, sweeping descender that crosses the baseline
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, organic script paired with a rigid, formal serif for structural balance.
graphicDevices: Diagonal corner banner in top right with sans-serif block text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, 80s casual elegance of the top line.
Matches the high-contrast serif style of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A soft-focus studio portrait of a woman with 80s feathered hair, wearing a pink sweater, reclining among draped pink and black satin fabrics against a grey background. Leave the top 20% of the image clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a thin pink horizontal line across the upper third. Above the line, place large white custom script text. Below the line, right-aligned, place a bold white serif subtitle.

verificationChecks: Is the hair texture voluminous and feathered?
Does the pink rule line separate the two text styles?
Is the black satin in the foreground highly reflective?
Is the lighting soft and diffused?

adjustableVariables: Color of the accent fabric (e.g., changing pink to teal)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact brand logos or corner text content
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the script text is legible despite the swashes.
Check that the pink color is consistent across the line and fabrics.
Verify the subject's pose feels relaxed and editorial.
Confirm the background remains a neutral, non-distracting grey.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + [Subject Description] + [Accent Color] satin drapes + grey backdrop + two-tier typographic header with [Script Style] over [Serif Style] separated by a thin rule line.
